purpose: Autonomous shooting PSS on the Krylov path (51 unknowns) finds a 17-stage ring's period

oracle.derivation: The period is the last row's time. ngspice-44.2 transient of the same ring from .ic v(c1)=0.1 (uic), 1 ms at a 1 ns step: mean spacing of the rising v(c1)=0 crossings in the second half is 2.642949e-05 s (spacings agree to 1e-8 relative). espice converges on it at h^2: 2.64574e-5 at 256 points, 2.64364e-5 (2.7e-4) at 512, 2.64312e-5 at 1024.
